name: petropro
description: PetroPro — The Complete Petrol Station Management Platform (modernized from legacy FoxPro 2.6)

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace apps/api & npm run dev --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/shared-types && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
